ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, with approximately 90% of the visible surface exhibiting dark pigmentation and 10% showing high-intensity white mottling at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across the central and proximal fluke surfaces; high-contrast, irregular white geometric blobs and focal spots are localized at the outer distal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated obtuse angle of approximately 120 degrees at the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated topography along the continuous trailing edge; significant high-amplitude jagged variations and jagged pixel disruptions are concentrated on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily linear sweep with moderate convexity along the trailing edge, ending in sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white spots observed within the pigmented regions at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular erosion and material loss on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or wear.
